description: This file contains utility methods to generate JWT tokens for testing purposes, specifically for creating authorized tokens for admin and normal users in a test environment.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: Helper class for creating JWT tokens for users with specific roles in tests.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for an administrator user.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a standard user without roles.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with specified user name and roles.
